content.short: BlockOwls is a Cardano NFT art project built around colorful owl characters and a shared fictional world.
content.description: BlockOwls is a Cardano NFT collection centered on illustrated owl characters, visual storytelling, and community participation. The project presents the owls as the first characters in a wider fictional universe, with each collectible contributing to a playful world of personalities, traits, and creative concepts. Built by artists and Cardano NFT enthusiasts, BlockOwls focuses less on marketplace utility and more on original art, character design, and a long-running community around the collection.
content.meta: The main goal is to make a playful and vivid fictional world - filled with a variety of characters. Explore BlockOwls on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
